findings.claim: Diagnostics for types and members declared in referenced assemblies are filtered out of the consuming compilation, so the consuming project will not report problems such as a missing [Key]. This matches the deliberate ownership model recorded in the ledger rather than being a regression.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Referenced-assembly types are deliberately not analysed; the defining assembly owns validation and formatting, so missing diagnostics for those types are not defects. The new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation filter and accompanying documentation implement that convention.
